results.title: Climate change, nature degradation and the ECB
results.content: # Climate change, nature degradation and the ECB. > We are firmly committed to taking climate change and nature degradation into account, within our mandate. Climate change and nature degradation pose risks to our economy and the financial sector. Our work on climate change and nature degradation focuses on three main objectives. We work to better understand, monitor and manage climate-related risks in our monetary policy and investment operations, as well as in the financial system. And we continuously adapt our work on climate and nature to reflect the ongoing improvements in the data and models we use to understand climate and nature-related risks. As part of our supervisory role, we are responsible for ensuring that banks manage risks, including those stemming from climate change and nature degradation. More on climate, nature, and banking supervision. We have set up the climate change centre to help shape and steer our climate and nature agenda, bringing together the work and expertise of different business areas.
